payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Astrid, Gillian, Harry, Mi, Reanna, Stefania

payload.content: Planning Phase (Iteration 1): I’m Gillian. Availability 7h; strongest skills ui-ux-design (0.87) and security (0.71). My likely feasible low-cost choices are ISSUE-0002 (Improve security) tasks; ISSUE-0001 tasks have very high cost for me. I will not claim ISSUE-0001. Please coordinate to avoid duplicates—if you want ISSUE-0001, take critical implement/review/test/docs/triage. I’m considering ISSUE-0002::review or ::test (and possibly ::implement if needed).

Stefania (security-heavy, 8h) planning for Iter1: I can take ISSUE-0002 security tasks (prefer review/test over implement). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 because costs are too high for me. Gillian flagged they’ll avoid ISSUE-0001; please confirm which ISSUE-0002 subtasks you want so we don’t duplicate.

Stefania proposal: if no one else takes it, I’ll claim ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.75, priority medium). Otherwise I can do ISSUE-0002::test (cost 2.45). Please reply with your intended picks (one per agent).

Mi (security-heavy, 5h) planning: I intend to take ISSUE-0002::implement (Improve security implement). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high cost. Please coordinate so others take remaining ISSUE-0002 subtasks (review/test) without duplication.

Reanna (api/ui-ux). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 (critical api) due to high costs vs availability. For ISSUE-0002 (Improve security), I’m considering taking ISSUE-0002::review or ::test to complement Mi (who plans implement). Please coordinate to avoid duplicates—confirm if anyone else wants review/test.

Harry here (avail 5h; skills ui-ux-design/security). To avoid duplicates with Gillian/Stefania/Mi: I will take ISSUE-0002::test if it's not already claimed; otherwise I will skip. Please confirm quickly.

Astrid planning: my top skill is ui-ux-design, availability 6h. From private costs, I can do ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.17, effort 1h) best; ISSUE-0002::test (cost 3.04, effort 1.4h) possible; ISSUE-0002::implement cost 4.34 (effort 2h) also possible but higher. I will avoid all ISSUE-0001 tasks (very high cost). I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review unless someone else already does it—please confirm to avoid duplicates.

Gillian here—given costs, I should take ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.57) OR ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.12). To avoid duplicates with Mi (implement) and Astrid/Stefania (review/test candidates), I propose I take ISSUE-0002::test. Please confirm no one else plans to take test; if test is taken, I’ll take review or skip.

Stefania planning confirm: I prefer ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.75, priority medium). To avoid duplicates: please note I’m NOT taking ::test or ::implement. If someone else already takes review, I can switch to ::test (cost 2.45) instead; otherwise I’ll claim review.

Stefania also confirms she will avoid ISSUE-0001 critical api-development tasks (too high cost). Remaining candidates: ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement. Please coordinate so each is claimed by at most one agent.

Mi confirmation (planning): I will take ISSUE-0002::implement only. Please ensure no other agent selects implement; feel free to coordinate remaining ISSUE-0002::review and ISSUE-0002::test between you without duplication.

Reanna (planning): Mi has locked ISSUE-0002::implement. I will take ISSUE-0002::test (or review if test already taken). Since no one else explicitly claimed test on BB0, my default claim is ISSUE-0002::test to avoid duplication. Please confirm if anyone is taking test; otherwise I’ll lock test on execution.

Harry here. I see Mi locked ISSUE-0002::implement. Reanna intends ISSUE-0002::test; Gillian Astrid also debated test/review. To avoid duplicates, I will not claim ISSUE-0002::test if Reanna is taking it. Please confirm on BB0 whether ISSUE-0002::test is already taken so I can either take ISSUE-0002::review (if free) or skip.
My intended pick (if available): ISSUE-0002::review. If someone already takes review, I will skip (avoid infeasible/duplicates).

Astrid planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, my cost 2.17) unless someone else has already explicitly taken review. Please confirm quickly whether ISSUE-0002::review is free to avoid duplicate claims.

Summary of feasible non-ISSUE-0001 options: Mi locked ISSUE-0002::implement; likely Reanna takes ISSUE-0002::test; multiple agents prefer review. I prefer to take ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip in execution.

Gillian planning update: I will take ISSUE-0002::review if it is unclaimed; otherwise I will take ISSUE-0002::test only if it is also unclaimed. I will not take ISSUE-0001. Please confirm whether review/test are already claimed so we avoid duplicates (priority medium).

Stefania (me): still available and can take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.75, effort 1h). I’m not taking test/implement, and I avoid all ISSUE-0001. Please confirm whether anyone already explicitly takes ISSUE-0002::review on BB0; if it’s taken, I will skip (not switching to test/implement).
Stefania coordination: if ISSUE-0002::review is free, I will claim it in execution. Otherwise I will skip rather than create a duplicate. No interest in ISSUE-0001 (too high cost).

Mi (planning): confirming I will only take ISSUE-0002::implement. I will not take review/test. Please coordinate so only one agent takes ISSUE-0002::review and only one takes ISSUE-0002::test; others should skip to avoid duplicates.

Reanna planning update: Mi locked ISSUE-0002::implement. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution (not review) to avoid duplicate with likely review claimers (Gillian/Astrid/Stefania). If test already taken, I will switch to skip rather than create duplicate.

Harry (planning): I will take ISSUE-0002::review only if unclaimed; Mi has implement locked and Reanna plans test. I believe review may be claimed by Astrid/Gillian/Stefania—please confirm if any of you are committing to review so I can avoid duplication (I’ll skip otherwise).

Astrid here: I’m planning to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if it’s unclaimed. Can someone confirm who (if anyone besides me) will take ISSUE-0002::review? I will skip if it’s already taken to avoid duplicates.
Astrid status: skills ui-ux-design; feasible low-cost task for me is ISSUE-0002::review (effort ~1h, cost 2.17). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 critical api-development tasks due to prohibitive costs.

Planning update from Gillian: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed in execution; otherwise I will take ISSUE-0002::test only if unclaimed. I will not claim ISSUE-0001. Please confirm on BB0 whether review/test are taken to avoid duplicates.

Stefania here (Planning Iter1): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review if and only if it’s unclaimed in execution; I will NOT take ISSUE-0002::test/implement and will avoid all ISSUE-0001. Please confirm whether anyone else besides you is locking ISSUE-0002::review.

Mi planning update: I will take only ISSUE-0002::implement. To avoid duplicates, please ensure ISSUE-0002::review and ISSUE-0002::test are claimed by at most one agent each (likely Reanna takes ::test; review should be taken by only one of Astrid/Gillian/Stefania). I will not take review/test and will skip any other tasks.

Reanna planning update: Mi locked ISSUE-0002::implement. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (not review) to avoid duplicate; if test is already taken on execution, I will skip (no switching to review per coordination).

Harry planning update: Mi locked ISSUE-0002::implement; Reanna intends ISSUE-0002::test. I intend to take ISSUE-0002::review in execution ONLY if it is unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates. Please confirm if anyone has already locked review.

Astrid planning: I will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates. I am not taking ISSUE-0001 tasks (too high cost). Can confirm whether any other agent besides me has locked ISSUE-0002::review?
